weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg2:start–seg2:end: a waffle of identical baby emoji titled 'Twin age factor 40+ 46%' with 'each = 1%', while the narration says mothers over 40 twin nearly five times more often than under-20 mothers. There is no under-20 group, no ratio, and Data just stands in the grid pointing.
weakest_scene.root_cause: A share/waffle chart was chosen for a RATIO comparison between two age groups. The comparison group is missing, so the picture asserts '46%', which the script never says.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Draw the two groups side by side: under-20 mothers with 1 twin pair for every ~5 pairs among 40+ mothers, filling as Data hands over each pair. The 5x gap should be visible without reading, and the numbers should come from the beat's data.

depictions.note: Horizontal bars, then a column/line race to 33.9. The values are labelled '%' although the claim is per 1,000, so the unit is wrong on screen.
An emoji waffle at 46% with no comparison group. It does not show 'five times more often'.
An area/line chart falling from about 28% to 2%. The decline reads, but it is a plain chart with Data riding the tip.
The closing reuses the IVF line chart; nothing shows 'two became the new one'.

grades.one_line: Every beat is a stock chart with Data cheering on top. The units are wrong (per-1,000 values labelled %), and the 'five times' beat shows an unrelated 46% waffle.
problems: Hook (hook@0.3–seg0:mid) is the same finished bar chart repeated with Data pointing; nothing happens in the first 2s beyond the mascot shuffling.
The twin rate is per 1,000 births, but every bar and headline labels it as a percent ('33.9%', '18.9%'), which misstates the stat by an order of magnitude in meaning.
seg2 waffle shows '40+ 46%' with no under-20 comparison, so the 'nearly five times' claim is never demonstrated.
Data uses the same arms-up pose riding line tips in seg1, seg3 and seg4. He causes none of the motion and overlaps the 1980 bar in seg1:start.
The closing 'Two really did become the new one' sits over the IVF decline chart, so the payoff contradicts the visual (a falling line).
Two different chart treatments of the same series in seg1 (horizontal bars, then a column/line race) look like a template switch rather than a build.
fixes: Relabel the twin-rate values as 'per 1,000' (e.g. '33.9 per 1,000') wherever they appear.
Replace the seg2 waffle with a side-by-side ratio picture (under-20 versus 40+ twin pairs, about 1:5) that Data fills himself.
Give Data an agent act for each beat: he stacks twin pairs to raise the rate in seg1 and pulls IVF twins out of the pile in seg3, instead of cheering on the line tip.
Open on motion: the twin count doubling in front of the viewer within the first second, not a pre-built bar chart.
Close on the doubling (twin pairs where there used to be one), not on the reused IVF decline chart.
